title: nightfall
description: nightfall's own metrics, scraped by the OTel collector into dusk.otel_metrics.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t, series, sum(latest) AS value FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(time) AS t, resource_attributes['service.instance.id'] AS series, resource_attributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, toString(attributes) AS attribute_set, argMax(value, time) AS latest
  FROM dusk.otel_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND service_name = 'nightfall' AND metric_name = 'nightfall_sessions'
  GROUP BY t, series, instance, attribute_set)
GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t

panels.title: Handshakes per second
panels.description: TLS handshakes by listener and outcome.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t, series, sum(increase) / $__interval_s AS per_second FROM (
  SELECT t, series, instance, greatest(highest - lagInFrame(highest, 1, highest) OVER (PARTITION BY series, instance, attribute_set ORDER BY t), 0) AS increase
  FROM (
    SELECT $__timeInterval(time) AS t, attributes['outcome'] AS series, resource_attributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, toString(attributes) AS attribute_set, max(value) AS highest
    FROM dusk.otel_metrics
    WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND service_name = 'nightfall' AND metric_name IN ('nightfall_handshakes_total', 'nightfall_handshakes')
    GROUP BY t, series, instance, attribute_set))
GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t
